name: Neuvau
source:
The inexperienced protagonist has left his parent's home to pursue a master's degree and stays as a guest at a family friend's house. After an unexpected night out in town, he becomes entangled with a mysterious woman and his life starts tumbling out of control.
What path in life will he choose? Will he let go and indulge in a sea of lust? Will he submit and willingly relinquish control? Will he become powerful and make his own path? Or will he fail and become a passenger in his own life?
